messages:
Jordan K: quick sync — planning to flip the cross-region failover gate for EU->NA fallback this afternoon. goal: enable sticky routing to prefer local model but fall back to NA when capacity drops below threshold. canary needs to be scoped to 2 EU services only.
Alex P: ack. which flag key are we toggling?
Jordan K: feature flag is `routing.cross_region_failover.v2`. we'll update `scope` to `eu:service-a,service-b` and set `canary_pct=5` initially.
Maya R: +1. what's the stickiness TTL and what happens to KV cache on fallback?
Jordan K: stickiness TTL = 30m. KV cache stays tied to the session id; when we fall back to NA we replay cache lookup but we won't evict until TTL. this avoids duplicate loads.
Sam L: can we do 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 30m windows? I want a short verification at each step and automated rollback if latency or 5xx spikes.
Jordan K: plan: 5% for 15m, check p99 latency and 5xx, then 25% for 30m. rollback triggers: +30% p99 over baseline OR +3x baseline error rate. ops-bot will gate.
ops-bot: automated check ready. Thresholds: p99_delta > 30% OR error_rate_multiplier >= 3. Will auto-revert and notify #eng-oncall.
Alex P: will update the flag via `ror` CLI: 
```
ror flag set routing.cross_region_failover.v2 --scope eu:service-a,service-b --canary 5 --sticky-ttl 1800
```
Maya R: confirm dashboards to watch: `infra-routing.p99`, `infra-errors`, `model-serving.qps`, and `cache.hit_rate`. I'll open a short grafana snapshot.
Sam L: I'll stub a synthetic load test against service-b to validate cache behavior post-failover. ETA 20m.
Jordan K: tagging @oncall for handoff once we hit 25%. @ops-bot will post status updates. please ping in thread when you flip.
Alex P: flipping in 5. I will post the `flag-change` event id.
ops-bot: flag-change recorded: id=fc-1961234000-01 user=Alex P.
Alex P: done — canary=5 applied. fc id above.
Maya R: seeing a small p50 uptick, p99 unchanged so far. cache.hit_rate steady.
Sam L: synthetic load looks fine at 5%. no errors.
Jordan K: OK moving to 25% in 10m if no regressions. leave any gotchas here.
Alex P: moving to 25% now. fc id=fc-1961234000-02
ops-bot: fc-1961234000-02 applied. monitoring: start window.
Maya R: quick note — service-a logs show two warning spikes at 12:07 but they were transient. error rate at 1.1x baseline. still under rollback multiplier.
Sam L: cache warmup completed for NA fallback paths. most fallbacks hit <2s.
Jordan K: perfect. I'll close the gate after 1h of stable metrics. thanks team :tada:
Alex P: thanks everyone.
Maya R: good job.
Sam L: handing back to eng-oncall for watch.
